questions.q: According to Trailhead's live certification catalog, as shown in this lesson, what is the current real name of the foundational admin credential?
options: Salesforce Certified Platform Administrator
Salesforce Certified Administrator
Salesforce Admin Professional
Certified Salesforce Operator
questions.explain: The lesson's screenshot and text confirm the credential's current live name is 'Salesforce Certified Platform Administrator.'

questions.q: What does the lesson say your LTV Customer Management System capstone already gives you toward exam preparation?
options: Nothing -- the capstone is unrelated to certification content
Only a resume bullet, with no exam value
A meaningful head start, since it already covers objects and fields, security, data management, and reports and dashboards
Full exam-equivalent certification on its own
questions.explain: The lesson states the capstone already covers a meaningful share of the Administrator exam's real territory.

questions.q: What does the lesson say Platform App Builder assumes on top of Platform Administrator skills?
options: Nothing additional -- the two credentials are identical
Only Apex programming skill
A separate, unrelated skill set with no connection to Administrator
The same security and data-model fluency, plus declarative application design decisions like object design, automation choices, and UI/layout considerations
questions.explain: The lesson describes Platform App Builder as building on the same foundation as Platform Administrator, adding declarative application-design skills.

questions.q: Why does this lesson avoid stating the exact question count, time limit, or domain-weighting percentages for these exams?
options: Because those numbers are classified and cannot be shared
Because that detail lives on each credential's own dynamic 'About the Exam' page, which updates independently and could be stale by the time it's read here
Because Salesforce exams have no fixed structure at all
Because practice exams always provide this information automatically
questions.explain: The lesson explains that exact exam-structure numbers live on a dynamic Trailhead page that can change, so quoting a specific figure risks teaching something already out of date.

questions.q: What role does the lesson say a practice assessment should play near your target exam date?
options: It should replace hands-on practice entirely
It should only be taken after the real exam
A readiness check, used close to the target date rather than as the primary study method
Practice assessments are discouraged entirely
questions.explain: The lesson recommends a practice assessment close to the target date as a readiness check, not the primary study method.
